summary: Order the primes; take Λ = {l induced by a top : l < l̄}, one prime of each conjugate pair.

steps.claim: Choose a well-founded strict order < on the finite places of E.

Λ = {l ∈ inducedPlace(tops) : l < l̄} is marked (grind), and covers: for a top τ, l(τ) ≠ l̄(τ), since (−p)^{o₀}·τ is again a top (o₀ odd, `placeOfInt_mul_mem_tops_iff`, m ∣ order, `IsServed.m_dvd_orderOf`) inducing the conjugate prime (`inducedPlace_neg_pow_mul_of_odd`); so one of l(τ), l̄(τ) is the smaller and lies in Λ.
steps.lean:
use {l ∈ D.tops.image inducedPlace | l < star l}, by grind, fun τ a ↦ by grind [h.m_dvd_orderOf, →
    Even.trans_dvd, D.inducedPlace_mul τ 1, orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one,
    inducedPlace_neg_pow_mul_of_odd, (D.placeOfInt_mul_mem_tops_iff h.2.2.1 τ a).2 dvd_rfl]
